To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the flow and heat transfer in curved tubes are significantly affected by several factors such as curvature radius, curvature angle, tube length, curvature type, tube diameter, and tube orientation.
heat transfer and flow in curved tubes is a complex phenomenon.
heat transfer and frictional characteristics of single-phase flow in coiled tubes are affected by several parameters such as Reynolds number, curvature ratio and tube geometry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of heat transfer characteristics of helically coiled heat exchangers.
the development of a novel heat transfer enhancement device for use in the heat exchanger.
the study of heat transfer and fluid flow characteristics in helically coiled tube heat exchangers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the heat transfer enhancement is more significant for the helically coiled and spirally coiled tube than for other coiled tubes.
the heat transfer enhancement in curved tubes is not as high as it is claimed in many studies.
the heat transfer enhancement and friction factor reduction in curved tubes are strongly dependent on the geometry of the curved tube and the fluid properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the single-phase heat transfer coefficient is increased by increasing the tube curvature ratio and the single-phase friction factor is decreased by decreasing the curvature ratio.
the heat transfer enhancement is achieved by the centrifugal force acting on the flow.
there are a lot of correlations and data for single-phase and two- phase heat transfer in helically coiled tube.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a need for more experimental and numerical studies to develop more comprehensive and accurate correlations for heat transfer coefficients and friction factors.
the single-phase heat transfer and two-phase friction factor correlations can be applied for the design of curved tube heat exchangers with an acceptable error.
the heat transfer enhancement is achieved at the expense of a higher pressure drop.
